items.name: Swami Samananda Saraswati
items.text: A disciple of Pujyasri Omkarananda Mahaswamigal, who named him as his successor. He was spiritually guided by Pujyasri Paramarthananda and Pujyasri Guruparananda, and has taught almost all major Vedantic texts in various locations. He has a special interest in teaching Thayumanavar Padalgal.

items.name: Swami Jnanasivananda Saraswati
items.text: A close associate of Pujyasri Swami Omkarananda Mahaswamigal for nearly four decades, from whom he received Sanyasa Deeksha. Swami Omkarananda and Swami Guruparananda were his spiritual guides. He conducts regular Vedanta classes in Theni, Dindigul and other locations.

items.name: Swami Purnananda Saraswati
items.text: A disciple of Pujyasri Omkarananda Mahaswamigal, from whom he received Sanyasa Deeksha. He completed the three-year Vedanta course conducted by Swamiji from 2000 to 2003 and is now a teacher of Vedanta, conducting classes at the ashram and other locations. For several years he has organized summer and Sunday camps for children, and he serves as editor of Vedaneri, the ashram's magazine.

omkarananda.name: Sri Swami Omkarananda
omkarananda.role: Founder and Chief Acharya, Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam
omkarananda.intro: Born in a traditional Vedic family, he learned the Vedas at a very early age. He grew into an outstanding teacher of Vedanta, known for his eloquence in Tamil and Sanskrit.
omkarananda.lifeTitle: A life of Veda and Vedanta

timeline.title: Born into a Vedic family
timeline.text: Sri Swami Omkarananda was born in a traditional Vedic family. He learned the Vedas at a very early age.

timeline.title: Sannyasa Diksha
timeline.text: In his early twenties, greatly inspired by the teachings of Sri Swami Vivekananda, he joined Ramakrishna Tapovanam at Tirupparaithurai. Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Maharaj gave him Sannyasa Diksha on May 4, 1985, and named him Sri Swami Omkarananda.

timeline.title: Touring Tamil Nadu
timeline.text: Sri Swamiji toured all over Tamil Nadu and conducted Antaryogams and classes on spoken Sanskrit.

timeline.title: Studying Vedanta
timeline.text: His quest for knowledge of Vedanta led him to Sri Swami Paramarthananda, a disciple of Sri Swami Dayananda Saraswati. Under his guidance he studied Vedanta.

timeline.title: Founding the Ashram
timeline.text: He founded Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam on the banks of the river Surabhi Saraswathi, also known as the Mullaiyaru, at Theni. He established the Vedanta Sasthra Prachara Trust to manage the Ashram.

timeline.title: Temple of Adiguru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti
timeline.text: In the precincts of the Ashram, Sri Swamiji established a grand temple dedicated to Adiguru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti. Its Maha Kumbhabhishekam was performed in June 2004, and the temple attracts a large number of devotees from all over the world.

timeline.title: Peetharohana at Pudukkottai
timeline.text: Sri Swamiji succeeded H.H. Sri Sri Santananda Swamigal of Sri Sri Judge Swamigal Adhishthanam, popularly known as Sri Bhuvaneshwari Avaduta Vidya Pitham, at Pudukkottai. This Peetham has a long history of conducting various homams and poojas.

omkarananda.todayIntro: Sri Swamiji was an outstanding teacher of Vedanta, known for his eloquence in Tamil and Sanskrit. His ability to present even the most intricate topics of Vedanta in an easily understandable manner won him a large following among grassroots rural communities.

roles.title: Chief Acharya of the Ashram
roles.text: He conducted Vedanta classes for the brahmacharis and satsangs for the Ashram inmates. Residential camps and antaryogams were also conducted by him.

roles.title: Teaching beyond the Ashram
roles.text: Recognizing his erudition, various organizations in India and abroad regularly arranged his discourse programmes. He also visited schools and colleges upon invitation and delivered lectures.

roles.title: Guidance in temple and ritual matters
roles.text: Devotees regularly consulted him on temple construction, poojas and rituals, and he was invited to preside over various temple Kumbhabhishekams and Vedic rituals. His erudition in both Karma Kanda and Jnana Kanda placed him in a unique position among all traditional acharyas.

omkarananda.listenTitle: Hear him in his own voice

meta.description: The Adi Guru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti Vidyapitham at Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam, Vedapuri, Theni: consecrated in 2004, a Gurusthalam where the Adiguru and the Devaguru bless devotees under one roof.

vidyapitham.title: Adi Guru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti Vidyapitham
vidyapitham.tagline: The Adiguru and the Devaguru, under one roof
vidyapitham.heroAlt: The Adi Guru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti Vidyapitham temple
vidyapitham.intro: The Vidyapitham stands inside the ashram grounds, with Adiguru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti as its presiding deity. With Devaguru Brihaspati also consecrated here, it is a unique Gurusthalam where both the Adiguru and the Devaguru bless devotees.
vidyapitham.aboutText1: The Adiguru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti Vidyapitham is inside the ashram grounds. Its presiding deity is Adiguru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti. Pujyasri Swamiji consecrated it in 2004.
vidyapitham.aboutText2: A trust, Sri Dakshinamurti Seva Samiti, manages its activities. With the consecration of Devaguru Brihaspati, the Vidyapitham at Vedapuri, Theni, became a unique Gurusthalam, where both the Adiguru and the Devaguru bless devotees under one roof.
vidyapitham.photoAlt: The Vidyapitham temple with its vimanam
vidyapitham.murtisText: Six deities, the Shanmatha Murtis, are consecrated in separate mandapams.
vidyapitham.kshetraText: The Vidyapitham has the four features by which a sacred place is known.

account.detailsText: Keep your details up to date. They are used to fill your sevas faster.
account.idSaved: Saved. Type a new number only to replace it.
account.familyText: Family members you can name in sankalpams.
account.familyEmptyText: Add your family so their names can be included in sankalpams.
account.familyMax: You can add up to {n} members.
account.sevasEmptyText: Book a seva and it will be listed here.
account.donationsEmptyText: Your donations will be listed here.
account.magazineText: Your print subscriptions and delivery details.
account.magazineEmptyText: Subscribe to receive the magazine at home.
account.campsEmptyText: Register for a camp and it will be listed here.
account.historyText: Every seva, donation and subscription, with receipts.
account.historyEmptyText: When you pay for a seva, donation or subscription it will appear here.
account.receiptNote: This is a demo acknowledgement. It is not a tax-exemption (80G) receipt. Official receipts will be issued after online payment is connected.
account.securityText: Your password, your data and your account.
account.errCurrent: The current password is not correct.
account.downloadText: Get a copy of your profile, orders and registrations as a file.
account.deleteText: This permanently deletes your devotee account.
account.deleteLine1: Your profile, photo, family details and saved ID numbers are erased.
account.deleteLine2: Your name, phone and address are removed from past orders. The order numbers and amounts are kept for the ashram’s accounts.
account.deleteLine3: This cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want a copy.
account.deleteConfirmText: To confirm, type DELETE and enter your password.
account.deleteAgree: I understand this cannot be undone.
account.errAgree: Please tick the box to continue.
